notes.title: Update 9- Army Rework
notes.notes:
Update 9 for Caravan Trade Tycoon includes the army and battle rework. There are also various UI improvements.  Taverns now have 2 more functions: waiting in the city and finding out the latest gossips.

Thank you for playing Caravan Trade Tycoon, do not hesitate to share any ideas and suggestions.

notes.title: Update 8- UI Rework
notes.notes: This update includes a UI rework. Most of the game's UI changed and improved. This update also includes various gameplay improvements and bug fixes.

notes.title: Update #7 City Events
notes.notes:
This update includes UI improvements, bug fixes, and the new event mechanic. A summary of the update:

Bug fixes including, but not limited to:

After loading a saved game, all item icons in the inventory were invisible. 
Clothing rate in the rate screen was white in some undesired cases.
In the player shop, it was impossible to scroll down the inventory to place items in lower slots.


Improvements including, but not limited to:

Now you can see 8 items in the shops, instead of 4.
Now rates for the items in the inventory are displayed. 
In the player shop, it was impossible to scroll down the inventory to place items in lower slots.
Now it is possible to change the game's resolution between 3 options.
Now right mouse button can be used to close tabs. 
Now the city you have clicked last is highlighted. 
Now you can see turn approximation before traveling to a city.


Various UI changes including, but not limited to:

City shop UI changed to fit more items in the shop screen. 
Inventory slots' UI changed to make space for rate display.
City panel's UI changed to make space for event image and distance approximation. Also, some of the texts replaced with icons.
Now it is more clear which perks are unlockable. 


New game mechanic City Events:

There are 12 different events right now.
All events have durations, so they keep changing.
 Most of the events affect price rates.


The next update will be focused on a new game mechanic that will enhance both player shops and workshops. If you have any suggestions, ideas, and complaints, feel free to share them.

notes.title: January Update - New City UI
notes.notes:
The last update was also focused on UI improvements. I was planning to add a crucial feature for the game in this update. Instead, I decided to change the city panel's UI. Because it was really confusing for the new players. Now it is a lot more simple and clean. Also, there are other UI improvements that are also for helping new players. There are also a few other gameplay improvements. The next update will be a lot more focused on a crucial new feature, which I am already working on.

notes.title: December Update - New Map
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, in this month's update the entire map has been remade, and I think it is the biggest change that game has experienced since the early access release. I liked the new map a lot more, and I think most of you will also like it. Other than that, this update also includes some bug fixes, a few UI improvements such as being able to close some menus with the "ESC" button, and a brand new and detailed filter system. 

The old filter system had some problems, for example, it was hard to see the symbols and it wasn't really detailed. Also, the color-coding wasn't proper, since every country had a different color for their background. But most importantly, the old filter system wouldn't work with the new map, since now we have city symbols instead of city names. So, I remade the entire filter system by also adding some new cool features such as adding cities to your favorites. Now you can easily follow which cities you have a workshop or shop in, or which cities have a high development.

notes.title: November Update - Seasons
notes.notes:
Attention: Old saves are not compatible with this update. However, it is possible to continue with an old save. Continuing with an old save may cause some game-breaking bugs. Starting a new game is highly recommended. 
Hi everyone, 
this month's update has some crucial bug fixes and new content. The theme of the update is the seasons. I think that seasons are a great addition for this game and it reflects what kind of game I am planning to develop in the end. Also, a game-breaking bug has been fixed. All the details about the update are here:


Seasons. Every season has effects on the price rates of each category. For example in Winter foods are more expensive, while weapons are cheaper. 
Fixed the bug where saving the game would take more than 5 seconds and may cause a crash. Now, saving shouldn't take more than 1 second if you have an average pc and it is not crashing anymore. 
 Various bug fixes. 
 Now you can see how much gold a city has from the city panel.
 Now with "filter" mode you can see which city has which workshop and whether you own a workshop or shop in that city or not.


Also, there is a known bug; after loading a previously saved game, the item images in the player inventory would disappear. However, if you buy a new item, its image would appear. Right now I am investigating it and the fix will come with next month's update (hopefully) since it is not a game-breaking bug. Here are some screenshots from the update:

notes.title: October Update - Player Shops
notes.notes:
The second update of the game is live. Thank you for all of your support. The main content of the update is the player shops. Now you can purchase shops in the cities and start to sell goods from there. You can adjust the price as much as you want. However, the more expensive the good is, the less chance for it to be sold. So you should pay attention to the city's rates while adjusting the price. Also, when you sell a good you gain some reputation points. If you gain enough reputation points, you can sell the goods for higher prices with a greater chance to be sold. Here is the full changelog:


[olist]
Player shops 

Now you can purchase shops in the cities
You can adjust the prices of the goods
Price affects the chance of the good to be sold
You can earn a reputation from selling goods in the shop. With a higher reputation, you can sell your goods at higher prices.

UI improvements for the city panel
UI improvements for the inventory
UI improvements for the city shop panel

Now you can filter the goods in the shop according to their category.
Now you can see the good's rate directly at the city shop.

Balance changes

Now caravan upgrades are cheaper.
Now purchasing and upgrading workshops are cheaper.
Now recruiting soldiers is cheaper.

Various Bug Fixes
[/olist]

You can find screenshots related to the update below. Also, don't forget to give your opinion and suggestions in the comments section.

notes.title: September Update - Perks and More
notes.notes:
The game has been published 1 month ago. I had lots of support from different people around the world. Thank you for all your ideas and suggestions. I am trying to develop the game according to the community. Here is the changelog for the first update:


Auto Turn: From now on you don't have to click on the next turn button every time. When you have a destination, turn would be passed automatically. 
Visual Feedback For Rates: Now rates screen has colors according to the rates of the city you are in. So when you check another city's rates, you will see that some categories are red while some of them are green. If the rate is green, then it is higher than the city you are currently in. If the rate is red, then it is lower than the city you are currently in.
UI Improvements: I now that the UI of the game is really bad right now. I am going to change the UI one by one. The first UI change is for the main screen(not the main menu, but the main screen you see while you are on the map). 
 Level: Now you can earn experience and level up. When you sell an item, you earn experience as the same amount of the money you earn. For example, if you sell a good for 350 golds, you would earn 350 experience points. When you have enough experience points, you would level up.
 Perks: Every time you level up, you will earn a perk point. With perk points, you can unlock perks. There are 2 different perk categories: Trade Perks and Army Perks. There are 41 perks right now, 3 less than the planned. 
 Game Balance for Bandits: Now bandits will start to appear a lot later. 
 Some bug fixes related to the war and army screen.
 Various little UI improvements.
